purpose: Close missing won_tackles from explicit approved total_tackles=0 using the Opta nonnegative subset definition. Derive signed legacy_net_tackles only from closed/just-qualified won and total counts. No BPS clipping or negative-value normalization.
controls: All available closed approved won/total pairs; use source regression and mathematical subset consistency, not an independent holdout. Never apply to protected conflicts or unknown totals.
application: Only empty missing_data targets. Unknown total is not zero. Positive totals without known wins remain unknown. Preserve all source values, non-target rows and previous failed source/BPS studies.
